mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the unemployment rate above 6% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in high-unemployment periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in business activity (GDP) signal accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of FEDFUNDS falling and GDPC1 rising does not occur, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the signal is active (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation-adjusted CPIAUCSL values in a late-cycle expansion indicate persistent upward pressure on prices, prompting cautious market anticipation of future rate hikes and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not exceed 255.5 (vintage 2020-04-01 value) or 20-day forward returns in the late-cycle regime are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate remains above 1.5%, it signals tight monetary policy, raising borrowing costs and dampening equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not remain above 1.5% for the 5-day horizon, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in business activity (GDP) and supply growth (INDPRO) indicates robust economic momentum, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO do not both rise simultaneously, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the signal is active (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rapid growth in labor market employment (PAYEMS) above 131,000 indicates strong job creation, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not rise above 131,000 in the 3-month window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the signal is active (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in industrial production (HOUST) and a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) reflects sector-specific demand imbalances, but the overall demand environment remains robust, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not rise while RSAFS falls, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when the signal is active (t-test p > 0.05).
